patterns: What machine learning model do you use?
What model do you use to predict the disease?
responses: Three classifiers vote on your symptoms: a Random Forest, a Support Vector Machine and a Naive Bayes model, all trained on a small public dataset. Because the data is limited, treat my result as a hint, not a diagnosis.
I combine a Random Forest, an SVM and Naive Bayes. They agree most of the time on the training data, but real symptoms are messier, so always confirm with a doctor.
